net_revenue_yoy.description: Net revenue YoY growth vs Q-4 baseline

cogs_margin_delta_bps.description: Cost of products sold as a percentage of net revenue, delta vs Q-4 baseline

rd_yoy.description: Research, development and engineering expense YoY growth vs Q-4 baseline

sga_margin_delta_bps.description: SG&A (marketing and selling plus G&A) as a percentage of net revenue, delta vs Q-4 baseline

interest_expense_yoy.description: interest_expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

interest_and_other_income_net_abs.description: interest_and_other_income_net absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
